notes:
New Features:

- The separate long-check tabs are merged into a single 2 h Channels Check tab with independent Site Channels Check and IPTV Channels Check ON/OFF controls.
- Site Channels Check now supports One Channel mode; when selected, page controls are hidden and the next started supported Site channel is tested by itself regardless of Site.
- The previous Start Site Check, Start IPTV Check and separate IPTV Auto Check controls are replaced by the new Site/IPTV Channels Check toggles.

Improvements:

- During an active Site Channels Check, Adult-TV-Channels.com streams use the same resolved/PVR-style playback path that proved more stable in the previous IPTV comparison. Normal .com playback outside Site Channels Check remains unchanged.
- Settings tab navigation now uses a single manual focus-navigation layer to avoid conflicts between Kodi-native setNavigation links and the Python action handler.

Important:

- Site Channels Check and IPTV Channels Check are mutually exclusive so both cannot arm the shared runtime lock simultaneously.
- Existing IPTV One Channel and group-anchor behaviour remain intact.
- Long-check timing, runtime state, Check Lock, AlarmClock/watchdog, log-copy, Save Log Only and shutdown behaviour remain unchanged.
